instruction: Write an XDP program that must track bidirectional 5-tuple flow sessions in LRU hash table 'flow_table_01'. Key: (saddr, daddr, sport, dport, proto). Return XDP_PASS for all traffic.
requirements: Define struct flow_key containing saddr, daddr, sport, dport, proto
Define BPF_MAP_TYPE_LRU_HASH map 'flow_table_01' with key struct flow_key and value __u64
Verify Ethernet, IPv4, and L4 transport header bounds against data_end
Populate 5-tuple key and atomically increment packet count in flow map
SEC("xdp") entry point and GPL license declaration
